## Final exam -- pre-experiment worksheet

Prior to meeting with your instructor, answer all of the following fields.

1. List all member of your group.
2. In 2-4 sentences, describe your experiment.
3. What is the experimental unit?
4. What is the explanatory variable (if applicable)?
5. How will randomization occur?
6. What is the response variable?
7. Is your response variable categorical or numeric?
8. What test do you plan to use to analyze the collected data?
